decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. By utilizing cards like Expressive Iteration, Ponder, and Brainstorm, the deck aims to consistently draw into relevant threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a suite of counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Pyroblast, the deck seeks to control the game tempo while dealing damage to the opponent. Additionally, the mana base consists of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler. Alongside utility lands like Karakas and Boseiju, the deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Hydroid Krasis to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent. With a mix of card draw, removal, and versatile threats, the deck aims to outmaneuver and outvalue the opponent in a longer game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with a combination of powerful planeswalkers, counterspells, and removal spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating incremental advantage through card selection and token generation. By utilizing synergies between cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Monastery Mentor, the deck seeks to outvalue the opponent and ultimately establish a dominant board position. The inclusion of cards like The Wandering Emperor and Snapcaster Mage further enhances the deck's versatility and ability to adapt to different matchups.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly establish lock pieces like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using acceleration with Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck is able to play threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also utilizes powerful red cards like Fireflux Squad, Fury, and Shatterskull Smashing to control the board and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of Hazoret the Fervent adds another strong threat to the deck's aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly generating mana through a combination of elves and Gaea's Cradle to produce massive amounts of mana for explosive plays. It uses cards like Glimpse of Nature and Green Sun's Zenith to draw through the deck and find combo pieces like Nettle Sentinel and Heritage Druid. With access to cards like Natural Order and Craterhoof Behemoth, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with a massive board presence and finish the game in a single swing. The deck's key strategy is to combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

The main idea of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly and efficiently cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Griselbrand, and Serra's Emissary onto the battlefield from the graveyard using cards like Exhume, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. The deck also includes discard spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect the combo. Additionally, the deck utilizes mana acceleration cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to accelerate its game plan. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

This deck aims to control the game through a combination of disruptive spells and land-based strategies. The key idea is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Mox Diamond and Elvish Reclaimer, while using Crop Rotation and Knight of the Reliquary to find key lands like Dark Depths and Maze of Ith. The deck also includes answers like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats, while utilizing powerful green cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Sylvan Library for card advantage. The ultimate goal is to create a strong board presence and outvalue the opponent through efficient land management.

This deck focuses on using efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also utilizes powerful sorceries like Expressive Iteration and cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to maintain card advantage and find the necessary pieces to close out the game quickly. Additionally, the deck includes some targeted removal in Lightning Bolt and Pyroblast to deal with opposing threats. A balance of aggression and disruption is key to this tempo-based strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cheat powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Through the Breach. This combo allows for explosive plays that can overwhelm the opponent and quickly secure victory. The deck also includes mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and rituals to help cast these expensive creatures ahead of schedule. The inclusion of Trinisphere helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while the deck aims to win the game in a few turns.

The primary focus of this Legacy Aggro - Death's Shadow deck is to quickly deploy efficient threats like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Hymn to Tourach, and Stubborn Denial. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by using cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to find the necessary pieces while maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of countermagic like Force of Will and Daze provides additional protection for the deck's threats, allowing it to be proactive while also having answers to opponent's threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana through rituals and mana-producing artifacts, allowing the player to cast a high storm count spell like Tendrils of Agony to win the game in a single turn. This deck utilizes draw spells and hand disruption to set up the combo, along with Burning Wish to search for key sideboard cards. The inclusion of Past in Flames enables the player to reuse key spells from their graveyard, while Veil of Summer provides protection against disruption spells. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently execute a storm combo to achieve victory.

This Dragon Stompy deck focuses on aggressive gameplay and disruption through mana denial with cards like Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Karn, the Great Creator to control the board. Jokulhaups and Ensnaring Bridge are included to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board control. The inclusion of Punishing Fire and Shatterskull Smashing provides additional removal and reach. The deck aims to lock down the opponent while overwhelming them with powerful threats like dragons.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to control the board and quickly close out games. It utilizes cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their plans with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also includes versatile cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to dig for important cards. The mana base is streamlined with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. This deck aims to be proactive and aggressive in its gameplay to outpace opponents.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering their spells, removing their threats, and controlling the board. The deck utilizes a mix of powerful control elements such as Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Jace, the Mind Sculptor, alongside efficient card draw and card selection like Brainstorm and Ponder. It also incorporates versatile removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt, as well as disruptive cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Blood Moon to further hinder the opponent's strategy.

The core idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo using cards like Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill your library, while also utilizing Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for additional value. This combo allows you to get Thassa's Oracle into play to win the game instantly. The deck also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo. Additionally, Aether Vial and Stoneforge Mystic provide flexibility and consistency in executing your game plan.

The main concept of this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt opponent's mana base with Blood Moon effects, while deploying aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss to apply pressure. Cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere also further disrupt opponent's game plan, while utilizing fast mana sources like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to power out threats quickly. The deck aims to control the board, prevent opponent from casting spells efficiently, and deal quick damage to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.
